description: GIPSIE Multi-GNSS Simulation and Test Environment is provided by TeleOrbit, Fraunhofer IIS and TeleConsult Austria; ESA project. The ESA project page identifies GIPSIE as the synthetic-data component of the Multi-GNSS Simulation and Test Environment. It combines constellation and intermediate-frequency simulators and can operate with recording and replay equipment. Geographic context: global (software applicability). Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Cost and access terms require confirmation with the provider. Licence: Not stated on the reviewed page; check provider terms before reuse.  The project concluded in May 2017. Current procurement, licence and support conditions are not stated on the reviewed page. Potential simulation use: Test receiver behaviour with repeatable constellation, signal and error scenarios. For catalogue navigation, platform-gnss-sdr offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
